The three main competitors of the South African retail giant Shoprite Holdings (owner of Shoprite and Checkers) are Pick n Pay, The SPAR Group, and Woolworths Holdings. These four companies form the core oligopoly dominating the formal grocery and food retail market in the region.

- **Pick n Pay:** A major national supermarket chain competing across multiple income tiers, notably going head-to-head with Shoprite's Usave via its Boxer brand.

- **The SPAR Group:** A large network of independent-store grocers providing widespread neighborhood market competition. [](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/shoprite-holdings-ltd/competitors/)

- **Woolworths:** A high-end retailer focusing on premium foods and clothing, though increasingly overlapping with Shoprite's Checkers updates.
